budget_items.what_was_recorded: Treasurer-Collector reported a $115,000.00 short-term borrowing for the October 31, 2011 storm maturing June 28, 2013, re-borrowed through a bid won by People's United Bank at .55%.
budget_items.quote: the note for that short term borrowing of $115,000.00 matures on june 28, 2013 and

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Treasurer-Collector reported $45,000.00 collected from the 36 tax title properties, with a further $51,000.00 expected, for just under $100,000.00 total.
budget_items.quote: of the 36 properties she has been dealing with she has collected $45,000.00 in taxes from those properties.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Interest rate charged is 16% once in tax title and 14% prior to tax title.
budget_items.quote: ms. mccaie replied that once they are in tax title the rate is 16% and 14% prior to tax title.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: For FY12, 19 new tax titles were recorded at the Registry of Deeds for approximately $54,000.00.
budget_items.quote: ms. mccaie stated that for fy12, 19 new tax titles were recorded for approximately $54,000.00 at the registry

budget_items.what_was_recorded: EPG representative said the proposed PPA changes had no financial implications.
budget_items.quote: mir. babcock replied there were no financial implications in regards to the changes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: NuGen said its agreement has no financial contingencies but it cannot proceed until the agreement is signed.
budget_items.quote: the agreement has no financial contingencies, but they cannot move on them until the agreement is signed off on.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer Commission agreed a reasonable concession would be for the connection extension at the project to be paid for by the sewer commission.
budget_items.quote: be paid for by the sewer commission at $100.00 per foot.

budget_items.topic: Eagle Heights plumbing and electrical permit fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Developer would still need to pay at least 85% of the plumbing fees and 87.5% of the electrical fees if the Town waived fees.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel stated the developer would still need to pay at least 85% for the plumbing and 87.5% of the electrical.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board asked whether the Town could give the building under a long-term lease for $1.00 instead of donating it.
budget_items.quote: could the town do a long term lease for $1.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Developer said taxes paid in Groton are $5,000.00 per year and in Townsend between $5,000 and $10,000.00.
budget_items.quote: he believes in groton the pay $5,000.00 per year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board member said $5,000.00 in taxes is too low for Lunenburg for a 40 unit building.
budget_items.quote: she thinks that $5,000.00 is too low for lunenburg and that the town needs to receive some reasonable tax revenue

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager does not believe the building is worth more than $140,000.00 and will check with the appraiser.
budget_items.quote: she does not believe the building is worth any more than $140,000.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrant totals were listed under Item 5 with no motion recorded.
